title: GRADE Evidence-to-Decision criteria
description: The criteria an Evidence-to-Decision framework judges, EACH EXPLICITLY, before a recommendation. They are judged and argued, never summed into a score. These are the criteria of the framework for clinical and public-health recommendations. Moved from smart-kg/methodologies/grade.md by bean wg7r, 2026-09-24 (owner: 'needs to be part of skill/SKOS'). Read with the `grade` skill.

source.note: Alonso-Coello P, et al. GRADE Evidence to Decision (EtD) frameworks: a systematic and transparent approach to making well informed healthcare choices. 1: Introduction. BMJ 2016;353:i2016

codes.label: Priority of the problem
codes.definition: Whether the problem the recommendation addresses is a priority.

codes.label: Desirable effects
codes.definition: How substantial the desirable anticipated effects of the option are.

codes.label: Undesirable effects
codes.definition: How substantial the undesirable anticipated effects of the option are.

codes.label: Certainty of evidence
codes.definition: The overall certainty of the evidence of effects, rated per the grade-certainty list.

codes.label: Values
codes.definition: Whether there is important uncertainty about, or variability in, how much the people affected value the main outcomes.

codes.label: Balance of effects
codes.definition: Whether the balance between desirable and undesirable effects favours the option or the comparison.

codes.label: Resources required
codes.definition: How large the resource requirements, or costs, of the option are.

codes.label: Certainty of evidence of required resources
codes.definition: The certainty of the evidence about the resources the option requires.

codes.label: Cost-effectiveness
codes.definition: Whether the cost-effectiveness of the option favours the option or the comparison.

codes.label: Equity
codes.definition: What the impact of the option on health equity would be.

codes.label: Acceptability
codes.definition: Whether the option is acceptable to key stakeholders.

codes.label: Feasibility
codes.definition: Whether the option is feasible to implement.
